# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| migration-assessment | `assets/migration-assessment.md`, filled | `dept-decision-rights`, OD lead, plant | Every component and interface inventoried; Each use case marked "must be preserved", "can be dropped" or "replace later"; A risk row and recovery-impact class per component; Ratings confirmed by the local owner; "continue as-is" written as baseline scenario |
| staged-migration-plan | Staged plan in the migration assessment | `deploy-appstore`, `deploy-cybersec` | Lowest-risk stage first; Each stage has resources, cost, risk and an exit criterion; Preconditions listed |
| per-location-cutover-checklist | `assets/cutover-checklist-and-backout.md`, checklist with RAG | `deploy-acceptance`, plant key user | Time plan communicated, outage window set, RAG status per item, key-user verification meeting held and recorded |
| back-out-plan | Back-out plan section of the same asset | `deploy-appstore`, `deploy-cybersec` | One per stage; Trigger and decision owner agreed before the outage window opens; Read by the people who would execute it |
| decommissioning-record | Decommissioning record in the same asset | `deploy-handover` | Old system switched off by a named person, server released, application list updated; No parallel paper or shadow system remains |
| open-items-list-per-location | List with the filled assets | `dept-risk`, `dept-decision-rights` | Open risks and blocked locations listed per location |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| migration-assessment | structure of `assets/migration-assessment.md` | OD lead |
| staged-migration-plan | manual | OD lead |
| per-location-cutover-checklist | structure of `assets/cutover-checklist-and-backout.md` | plant key user |
| back-out-plan | manual | OD lead |
| decommissioning-record | manual | OD lead |
| open-items-list-per-location | manual | OD lead |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `invest-screen`, `funnel-requirements`, `deploy-cybersec`
- **Next:** deploy-appstore and deploy-cybersec (step 3a5, deployment package and back-out plan), deploy-acceptance (verification list and test evidence), deploy-handover and know-training (step 3a6, service concept and retire-the-old-process owner), dept-risk for open risks.: `deploy-appstore`, `deploy-cybersec`, `deploy-acceptance`, `deploy-handover`, `know-training`, `dept-risk`
- **Stops here when:** preconditions or the back-out plan are missing, the outage window is not announced, the key user is not available, a customer audit or fixed external date is near, or an owner has not confirmed a rating
- **Stops here when:** No stage starts and nothing is decommissioned before key-user verification and the agreed observation period
